sql: SELECT 'fn' AS k, p.proname || ' definer=' || p.prosecdef || ' anon=' || has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') || ' auth=' || has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') AS txt FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND p.proname IN ('hub_health','hub_dashboard_metrics') UNION ALL SELECT 'table', c.relname || ' rls=' || c.relrowsecurity FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relname = 'hub_weekly_summaries' UNION ALL SELECT 'policy', policyname || ' | ' || cmd || ' | ' || coalesce(qual, '') FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename = 'hub_weekly_summaries'
